title: Keep managed workspace states sticky and show multiple session indicators
description: Managed Claude/Codex statuses can be downgraded by later passive terminal output after a user-input or approval prompt opens, and workspace rows collapse multiple active sessions into a single misleading scalar state. Keep pending input/approval sticky until user input resolves them, and let workspace summaries/sidebar UI carry multiple session activities while preserving aggregated project indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Managed Claude/Codex awaiting-input and pending-approval states remain active across later passive output until the user responds; workspace rows and overview chips can show more than one active session; project indicators remain aggregated by priority.

title: Run project setup commands for worktrees
description: Execution mode: AFK\nPersist a project-level worktree setup command, run it after Aide creates a worktree, expose durable per-workspace setup state and bounded logs, allow retry/cancel/manual run for attached or root worktrees, and gate managed-agent startup until required setup succeeds. Run commands in the worktree using the user shell. Preserve failed worktrees for repair and exclude setup command/output from support bundles.
acceptance_criteria: A project can define and clear a setup command; newly created worktrees run it exactly once before managed agents are enabled; root/attached worktrees do not auto-run but support an explicit run; success/failure/cancel/retry state survives renderer reload and app relaunch; duplicate runs are prevented; failure preserves terminal access and the worktree; command execution is cwd-scoped, cancellable, and tested without leaking command/output into diagnostics.
close_reason: Implemented and merged in GitHub PR #21; all local Linux quality gates pass.

The desired menu shows provider-specific Reasoning and Context Window sections. Never display unsupported Ultracode/Ultrathink/context choices as functional. Current menu shows discovered reasoning efforts and Codex service tiers; 1M model values remain selectable through the model picker.

title: Workspace runtime activity state in sidebar

acceptance_criteria: Workspace rows show runtime activity such as working, awaiting input, attention, ready, and error; project rows/rail aggregate child workspace state; overview cards show the same activity signals; fake summary overrides are removed for real workspaces; targeted tests and relevant UI/build checks pass

title: Replace unconditional Linux software rendering with a fallback
description: Every Linux launch forces llvmpipe/SwiftShader, disables hardware acceleration, GPU compositing, and the GPU sandbox. This is a major rendering and power regression and weakens sandboxing even on healthy systems.
acceptance_criteria: Hardware acceleration remains enabled by default; a documented flag or detected failure enables software fallback; diagnostics identify the active mode; headless CI remains reliable.

title: Keep newly imported workspaces empty instead of seeding placeholder panes
description: Real imported workspaces were still inheriting the demo fallback pane layout, which made repo-root workspaces open with chat/terminal/git splits instead of an empty shell.
acceptance_criteria: Real non-demo workspaces without a persisted layout render empty with no fabricated pane tabs; demo workspaces keep the seeded fallback layout.

title: Restore bun test as a trustworthy repo-wide gate
description: The default bun test command still fails for repo-level reasons unrelated to the current pane-registry work. It is pulling in the Playwright Electron suite directly, node:sqlite-backed tests still fail under Bun, and project-picker.test.ts still depends on vi.stubEnv in a runtime where it is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: bun test excludes or delegates Playwright correctly; SQLite-backed tests run under a supported runtime or explicit alternative command; project-picker.test.ts uses an environment-stubbing approach supported by the chosen runner; repo docs/scripts reflect the intended default test command.

title: Keep terminal panes recoverable after shell exit
description: TerminalPane currently closes and deletes the entire pane whenever its PTY exits, including an intentional shell exit. This loses layout context and offers no restart path.
acceptance_criteria: PTY exit leaves the pane and layout intact, reports the exit code, and exposes a restart action that starts a fresh session; headless Electron coverage proves the behavior.

title: Fix top-bar pane creation to use horizontal pane track
description: Top-bar pane creation currently behaves like a weighted split insertion, leaving the previous pane visible as a collapsed strip. Treat new panes as top-level horizontal pane-track targets so the active pane owns the viewport and prior panes move off-canvas instead of shrinking onscreen.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a pane from the top bar makes the new pane the active full-scene pane; prior panes remain reachable by horizontal navigation without staying visible as collapsed slivers.

title: Production OTA updates
description:
Execution mode: HITL
Deliver secure, staged over-the-air updates for packaged Linux x64 AppImage and signed/notarized macOS x64/arm64 builds. Cloudflare R2 is the public origin; Beads remains authoritative and Linear mirrors delivery.
acceptance_criteria: A manually installed updater-enabled bootstrap can update to a higher signed version on Linux and native macOS; unauthorized or revoked artifacts fail closed; active work is never interrupted without consent; staged rollout, telemetry opt-out, rollback, runbooks, and all repository gates are proven.

title: Establish authoritative OTA contracts and updater manager
description: Execution mode: AFK\nAdd exact-pinned electron-updater, versioned shared contracts, an injectable main-process update manager, revisioned IPC/preload delivery, automatic checks/downloads, unsupported-install detection, and sanitized errors.
acceptance_criteria: Fake-provider tests prove every transition, command deduplication, stale callback rejection, subscribe-before-snapshot reconciliation, stable-semver enforcement, and packaged/dev/AppImage/manual-only behavior. bun run test:node, bun run check, and bun run build pass.
close_reason: Merged PR #26: authoritative OTA manager, typed IPC/preload state, capability gates, exact electron-updater pin, runtime import guard, revision reconciliation, automatic checks/downloads, and 17/17 Electron coverage.

title: Verify signed OTA envelopes and downloaded artifacts
description: Execution mode: HITL\nAdd deterministic release-envelope generation, offline Ed25519 signing/verification, embedded public-key rotation, origin and target validation, deterministic rollout cohorts, revocation, and pre-install artifact digest verification.
acceptance_criteria: Valid signed envelopes are accepted; malformed, stale, wrong-key, wrong-product, wrong-platform/arch/origin, downgraded, revoked, and tampered envelopes fail closed. A changed AppImage cannot install even with plausible updater metadata. Signing private keys never enter source, CI, artifacts, logs, or support bundles.
close_reason: Merged in PR #27 with signed-envelope verification, digest hardening, and offline signing tests.

title: Persist OTA preferences and coordinate safe update restart
description: Execution mode: AFK\nAdd migration 8 for update preferences, disclosure, local cohort identity, snooze, bounded health queue, and post-update reconciliation. Add a single quit coordinator for normal and update-install shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Migration/reopen/cleanup tests pass; opt-out clears queued telemetry; raw errors and artifact paths are never persisted; active work requires explicit confirmation; graceful shutdown precedes quitAndInstall exactly once without before-quit recursion.
close_reason: Merged PR #29 after independent security review and full Linux CI.

title: Deliver accessible OTA update UX
description: Execution mode: AFK\nAdd the top-bar update indicator, application-level update modal, command-palette actions, progress, retry/snooze, critical update treatment, auto-download and telemetry controls, disclosure, and active-work restart warning.
acceptance_criteria: All updater states are demonstrable through an injected fake service; background checks do not steal focus; focus restores correctly; progress is announced; critical state remains visible; no nested interactive controls or accessibility violations are introduced.
close_reason: Merged PR #31: accessible OTA indicator/modal/commands, persisted privacy disclosure and opt-out, race-safe hydration, actionable failures, snooze expiry, active-work restart confirmation, dev-only fake update service, and 20-scenario Electron coverage.

title: Publish immutable OTA releases through Cloudflare R2
description: Execution mode: HITL\nCreate the protected build/assembly/promotion workflows for immutable R2 artifacts, merged macOS metadata, blockmaps, aggregate checksums, CycloneDX SBOMs, attestations, signed promotion records, short-lived scoped credentials, read-back verification, and rollback/revocation.
acceptance_criteria: A tag matching package version builds only from protected main; native Linux/macOS jobs produce exact assets; no matrix job can overwrite shared metadata; versioned objects are immutable; channel publication happens last after signature/read-back verification; unapproved or unsigned promotion is impossible.
close_reason: Merged PR #28: native release assembly, protected R2 promotion, signed channel commit, immutable audit artifacts, aggregate checksums, CycloneDX/provenance attestations, bounded exact readback, runbook, and CI-covered release tests.

title: Add privacy-preserving OTA rollout health
description: Execution mode: HITL\nAdd a Cloudflare Worker/D1 health endpoint, strict event schema, rate limiting, bounded client queue, first-run disclosure, opt-out, 30-day raw retention, anonymous aggregates, and manual 10/50/100 health gates.
acceptance_criteria: Only documented updater fields are accepted; IP, headers, user agent, prompts, paths, projects, repositories, and workspace data are never persisted; opt-out sends no health events; retention purge and rate limits are tested; rollout never auto-promotes.
close_reason: Merged PR #30: privacy-preserving OTA health with consent gating, bounded queue/upload, D1 retention/aggregation, staged manual gates, failure isolation, hardened endpoints, coarse timing, locked Wrangler/sharp, and full CI.

title: Prove packaged OTA bootstrap, upgrade, revocation, and recovery
description: Execution mode: HITL\nRun the full public-release drill: manually install the first updater-enabled bootstrap, OTA to the next patch, preserve userData and native PTY behavior, revoke a downloaded update, and recover with a higher patch on Linux AppImage and native macOS x64/arm64.
acceptance_criteria: All repository gates, signed-envelope fixtures, Linux packaged upgrade, native signed/notarized macOS upgrades, console/accessibility smoke, SBOM/provenance/read-back verification, halt/revocation, hotfix recovery, clean git status, Beads sync, and push evidence are recorded.

title: Embed trusted OTA configuration and automate the Linux packaged upgrade drill
description:
Execution mode: HITL
Replace launch-environment-only OTA configuration with validated protected build-time origin/public-key/health inputs for packaged apps. Add a hermetic Linux AppImage acceptance drill using an ephemeral test key and local trusted HTTPS feed to prove bootstrap, explicit upgrade, userData/native PTY preservation, tamper and revocation rejection, and higher-patch recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Tagged packages fail closed without a normalized owned HTTPS origin and non-development public key; packaged apps use the compiled trust configuration and cannot be redirected by launch environment; no private key enters source/build output/logs. A reproducible Linux x64 gate builds bootstrap and target AppImages and proves explicit install, same userData, native PTY, tamper rejection, signed revocation, and higher-patch recovery with actionable artifacts/logs.
close_reason: Merged PR #32. Trusted build-time OTA config, cache-only packaged updater metadata, and hermetic Linux AppImage 0.1.0→0.1.2 revocation/recovery drill passed with clean exit, no attacker requests, preserved state/native PTY, and coarse evidence.

title: Discover Claude models from the installed provider

close_reason: Replaced hardcoded Claude catalog with native SDK discovery. Real installed account model list verified. Effort-free models remain selectable, stale effort removed, model descriptions shown. 19 focused integration tests and production build pass.

title: Audit stability and current T3 Code parity
description: Run the application headlessly, establish a verified baseline, compare Aide with the current upstream T3 Code architecture and recent behavior, document required journeys and ranked defects, and create evidence-backed follow-up beads.
acceptance_criteria: A durable audit identifies reproduced failures separately from code risks, records the exact upstream revision, defines must-work journeys and execution order, captures verification results, and files actionable beads for remaining P0/P1 work.

title: Prevent Electron E2E teardown hangs in CI
description: PR #25 CI attempt 1 timed out in Playwright afterEach while closing Electron for the full-size pane navigation scenario. All assertions had completed far enough for the remaining 16 scenarios to pass on a replacement worker, and the same commit passed a separate full CI run, indicating a teardown flake rather than a product regression. Make Electron app shutdown deterministic and retain useful process diagnostics when close exceeds the expected bound.
acceptance_criteria: The affected E2E scenario can be repeated under Xvfb without afterEach or worker teardown timeouts; app/process cleanup is bounded and reports diagnostics on failure; the full Electron suite remains green.

description: Polish chat and desktop navigation: queue previews and numeric-version retry fix; square removable thumbnails and sent attachment persistence; HeroUI settings with shortcuts and animation preferences; deduplicated name-ranked skill search; Material Shell navigation with stable pane positions and Alt+Up/Down; right-side fleet slide and fully collapsing left sidebar with content movement; non-clickable aligned aIDE branding; close buttons on pane tabs; one focus ring on settings search; close numeric shell exits; autofocus active agent composer; agent-only workspace activity badges; direct native Codex follow-ups through Jev. Preserve concurrent Claude edits and run desktop checks on a virtual display. Verify production build, unit tests, Electron flows, saved preferences, and narrow layouts. Native Claude follow-ups are tracked separately in aide-0t8.
close_reason: Desktop polish verified: 632 unit tests, 43 Electron scenarios across complete and targeted runs, TypeScript/build/Biome and renderer size limits pass. Includes provider menus, Fable 5.1/icon, Ctrl+B left sidebar, removable mentions, hidden healthy Jev status, native Codex follow-ups. Inline file search and naming continue in aide-1rv/aide-2pp; Claude follow-up mapping and context variants have separate tickets.

close_reason: Matched hover wave, centered short tick stacks, aligned prompt/reply preview to selected tick, and made selected tick longest and white. Removed requested workspace/branch footer labels. Build, scoped Biome and two isolated desktop checks pass; screenshot inspected.
